title: Airport to City Center Taxi (Prepaid)
routeOrItem: Jaipur Airport -> Pink City / MI Road
tip: Always take the official prepaid taxi booth inside arrivals or app cabs. Avoid touts standing at the exit door.

title: Auto Rickshaw (Short hop 3-5 km)
tip: Insist on the meter or agree on ₹60-70 before boarding. Refuse commission-based textile shop detours.

title: Goa Airport (Dabolim) to Calangute/Baga Taxi
routeOrItem: Dabolim Airport -> North Goa Beach Belt
tip: Book via GoaMiles app or Goa Govt Prepaid counter. Private taxi mafia frequently demands ₹2,500+.

title: Manali Mall Road to Solang Valley Taxi
routeOrItem: Mall Road -> Solang Valley (Round trip with waiting)
tip: Fixed union rates exist. During peak snow season touts quote ₹3,500+. Always verify with Himachal Tourism booth.

title: Agra Cantt Station to Taj Mahal East Gate
routeOrItem: Agra Cantt -> Taj Mahal East Gate
tip: Auto drivers will tell you Taj Mahal is closed for VIPs and offer marble emporiums. It is rarely closed except Fridays.

title: Varanasi Ganges Sunrise Boat Ride (Rowing)
routeOrItem: Assi Ghat to Dashashwamedh Ghat (1 hour)
tip: Private boatmen ask ₹1,500-2,000 from foreign tourists. Standard boat shared is ₹150, private row boat ₹400-500.

title: Authentic Rajasthani Thali
tip: Top heritage thalis cost ₹350-450. Beware tourist dhabas with no printed menu charging ₹800.

title: Goan Fish Curry Rice Lunch
routeOrItem: Standard Goan Fish Thali at local beach shack
tip: Kingfish may be seasonal; confirm fresh catch weight and price per piece in advance before order.

title: Street Food Tasting (Chaat, Kachori, Lassi)
tip: Standard Peda/Kachori is ₹20-30 each, Clay pot Lassi is ₹40-60. Always pay standard counter price.

title: Cozy Hostel Bed (AC Dorm)
routeOrItem: Backpacker Hostel Dorm Bed with Locker & Wi-Fi
tip: Includes Zostel/Hosteller standard rates with clean linen and filtered water.

title: Heritage / Boutique Double Room (Standard)
routeOrItem: Mid-range Heritage Haveli or Hillview Cottage
tip: Walk-in rates quoted by middlemen on street are 40% marked up for commission. Book directly or compare online.

title: Goa Beachfront Cottage (Non-Peak)
routeOrItem: Wooden Beach Hut with attached bath
tip: Check plumbing and AC before paying upfront. Never pay non-refundable deposit to beach touts.
